what_this_does_not_establish: that the route is right in general. Four filings at one period each were read, and the two judgements that carry weight - Ford's whole-note scope and Enphase's footer - each rest on one filing.
what_this_is: the four D02 results that had no independent reading, read in both directions: every excerpt the selector took, judged against the approved source (Item 3, legal proceedings, contingencies notes) and the Spec's entity_scope of registrant; and every block inside a declared scope that it did not take, in the narrow scopes where reading all of them is possible.
why_the_broad_scope_is_not_read_here: ITEM_8 runs to over a thousand blocks in each filing and the blocks it admits get in through the _LEGAL keyword proxy. That direction was already measured across all eleven saved periods - 24 admitted, 19 correct, 5 wrong - and the five wrong ones belong to Pfizer, Lumen and Paramount, none of which is in this group. The complementary direction, whether any contingencies or legal-proceedings note heading goes unreached, was also already measured across all eleven.
